{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    round_scores = case['round_scores']
    round_targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case['forced']
    history = []
    selected_set = set()
    for scores, target in zip(round_scores, round_targets):
        sorted_indices = [i for i, _ in sorted(enumerate(scores), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)]
        round_indices = sorted_indices[:target]
        round_indices.sort()
        history.append(round_indices)
        selected_set.update(round_indices)
    selected_set.update(forced)
    retained_indices = sorted(selected_set)
    return {
        'history': history,
        'retained_indices': retained_indices
    }"
}
